metadata.technology_specification: Real-Time Quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (qPCR) Thermocycler
metadata.technology_reasoning: Real-Time PCR thermocyclers are the standard platform for qPCR instruments due to their ability to perform thermal cycling with precise temperature control and detect fluorescence signals simultaneously, enabling quantitative analysis of nucleic acids. They represent the dominant market technology in genetic and molecular biology laboratories as of 2024.

components.reasoning: This is the core component responsible for precise temperature cycling, universally present in all qPCR machines as the fundamental function for DNA amplification.
Essential for real-time monitoring of fluorescence signals indicating DNA amplification; typically includes excitation light source, filters, and photodetectors, and is a separate major module.
This component holds the PCR tubes or plates and provides the interface between the samples and the thermal cycler, a distinct assembly procured or manufactured separately.

components.component: Control Electronics and User Interface Module
components.reasoning: Includes microcontrollers, display, input controls, and firmware managing thermal cycling and data acquisition; a distinct electronic subsystem standard in all instruments.
Present in some integrated qPCR systems with automated sample handling; not universal but a separate module when included.
Hardware frame protecting internal components and providing structural support, standard though designs may vary.
